method: The 288-line synthetic corpus bench/corpus/clean.txt is corrupted by each of the 19 noise families and by `mixed` at 7 noise levels with seeds 1 to 3, and every result is scored. The output is deterministic integers, so every run gives the same bytes: this file records that three fresh runs of the command below were byte-identical to the committed docs/score-vs-noise.csv and .svg, that `glyphsift bench --verify` printed `verdict: PASS` for it, and the wall-clock time of each run (process start included). The raw result is docs/benchmarks/score-vs-noise.csv, a byte-identical copy of docs/score-vs-noise.csv (which the tests, the chart and the source package read).
